# MiniHisab (minihisab.com)
> A modern, cloud-first Point of Sale (POS), Inventory Management, and GST Billing software platform tailored specifically for retail stores, wholesale godowns, and multi-outlet chains in India.

## Overview
MiniHisab is designed to solve the real operational bottlenecks of Indian retail and wholesale businesses:
- Peak evening counter billing bottlenecks and cashier speed.
- Master carton wholesale purchasing versus loose unit retail sales.
- Real-time stock transfer challans between retail branches and central godowns.
- Untracked customer credit (Udhar Khata) and paper registers.
- GST compliance (CGST, SGST, IGST) with instant 80mm thermal receipts and A4/A5 laser tax invoices.
- Zero hardware lock-in: runs in any modern browser across Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS, connecting seamlessly to standard ESC/POS USB/Bluetooth thermal printers and 1D/2D barcode scanners.

## Core Capabilities

### 1. Point of Sale & Rapid Counter Billing
- 0.8s barcode auto-scan with auditory beep verification.
- Keyboard-only navigation for cashiers (zero mouse dependency).
- Split tender options: Cash, UPI QR code, Debit/Credit Card, and Store Credit.
- Support for 58mm and 80mm ESC/POS thermal printers with automatic cash drawer kicks.
- Multi-cart hold and resume without losing scanned customer items.

### 2. Multi-Tier Inventory & Master Carton Conversion
- Automatic conversion between master cartons, inner boxes, and loose retail units (e.g. 1 carton = 24 pieces).
- Low stock alarms with customizable reorder minimum levels.
- Real-time stock ledgers with batch numbers, manufacturing dates, and expiry monitoring.
- Bulk Excel/CSV product catalog import in seconds.

### 3. Multi-Outlet & Godown Synchronization
- Centralized head-office management for franchise chains and multi-branch retail businesses.
- Inter-outlet stock transfer dispatch challans and receiving verification workflows.
- Branch-specific sales velocity, gross margins, and comparative profit analytics.
- Central godown distribution to retail counter outlets.

### 4. Digital Customer Khata & Udhar Ledger
- Digital running balances (debit/credit) replacing traditional physical red books (bahi khata).
- Automated customer credit limits and overdue payment alerts.
- Partial and full settlement tracking with receipt generation.
- Full ledger download and printing for customer reconciliation.

### 5. Indian GST Tax Compliance
- Automatic HSN/SAC code tax slab calculation (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%).
- A4/A5 tax invoices formatted with vehicle details, transporter ID, and buyer GSTIN verification.
- 80mm compact B2C cash memos with summary tax breakdowns.
- One-click GSTR-1 and tax summary exports for accountants.

### 6. Role-Based Access Control & Staff Security
- Fast 4-digit PIN login for counter cashiers.
- Sensitive wholesale purchase costs and gross profit margins hidden from counter staff.
- Tamper-proof audit logs recording bill voids, cancellations, and manual discounts.

## Operational Advantages Over Traditional Systems

### Cloud Architecture vs Offline Desktop Software
- **Cloud Architecture**: MiniHisab is true cloud-native. Multi-outlet sync is instant in real time across any device (desktop, tablet, mobile) without local database sync corruptions.
- **Counter Speed**: MiniHisab is optimized for fast retail lines with rapid hotkeys, barcode continuous scanning, and thermal printing.
- **Carton Conversion**: MiniHisab natively tracks master cartons and loose units simultaneously.
- **Hardware Agnostic**: MiniHisab requires no heavy desktop installation or proprietary drivers; works directly through modern browsers.

### Retail Counter Speed vs Specialized Hospitality Tools
- **Vertical Focus**: Built specifically for retail shops, supermarkets, kirana, pharmacies, apparel, hardware, and wholesale distributors.
- **Unit Complexity**: MiniHisab handles retail SKU matrices, barcode inventory, carton-to-unit conversions, and customer udhar khata.

### Modern Usability vs Complex Legacy ERPs
- **Ease of Use**: Clean, intuitive interface with zero learning curve for cashiers.
- **Modern Hardware Support**: Direct web-based thermal printing and mobile device support without expensive dedicated server setups.

## Target Industries
- Kirana & Grocery Stores
- Pharmacies, Chemists & Medical Outlets
- Clothing, Apparel & Footwear Stores
- Hardware, Electrical & Sanitaryware Shops
- Wholesale Stockists & FMCG Distributors
- Electronics & Mobile Accessories Shops
- Bakeries, Sweet Marts & Confectionery
- Bookstores & Stationery Outlets
